rationale: The assistant correctly identified a failed fan oven element, prompted the customer to isolate before opening the back panel, and confirmed the diagnosis only after the customer reported a visible blister and black mark. It did not wrongly claim compatibility and told the customer to match the part using the model number. Minor weaknesses: it guessed a model format ('IFW 6340'), it did not ask for the actual model number, and it suggested checking the isolator by trying the grill or light. It also did not address the thermostat light that stays on, which is a minor point because the diagnosis was correct.
